name: iPhone Bridge
author: kbbahaPro
description: Mirror iPhone notifications, now playing, and battery into the Omarchy bar over Bluetooth LE, using Apple's ANCS and AMS. Dismiss from the desktop, auto-copy 2FA codes, and focus mode.

barWidget.description: iPhone notifications in the bar: unread badge, scrollable history, and dismiss straight from the desktop.

schema.label: Auto-copy login codes
schema.description: Pull 2FA/OTP codes out of notifications and put them straight on the clipboard.

schema.label: VIPs (allowed to interrupt focus)
schema.description: Comma-separated apps or sender names that still pop a toast in focus mode. Example: slack, mail, mom, acme

schema.label: Show desktop popups
schema.description: Raise a normal desktop notification for each iPhone notification. Do Not Disturb still applies.

schema.label: Silenced apps
schema.description: Comma-separated app names or bundle ids that should never pop a toast. They still appear in the panel. Example: games, com.apple.news

schema.label: Notifications kept
schema.description: How many notifications to keep in the panel and on disk.

schema.label: Pairing name
schema.description: The name this machine shows under Bluetooth on your iPhone while pairing.
